verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Customer.io letting a user issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent; the CLI is described as giving agents "full access" to workspaces. The MCP read/write/delete categories are client-side approval settings rather than credential scoping, and the per-integration data-in API keys exist for data sources, not as agent credentials with configurable scopes. Both are adjacent features that earn no credit.
